title: Alex Delamer
text:
I am a student in the Masters of Business Analytics at Monash University, and hold an undergraduate degree in Zoology from Trinity College Dublin. I have previously worked in the telecommunications industry in Ireland, at a small company that supplied fibre optic installation and testing equipment to a large section of the Irish market.
In my euphemistically named “free” time, I work as a freelance esports broadcaster for TrackMania and Rocket League.
My background has given me a varied interest when it comes to statistical work; I am equally comfortable with ecological datasets and logistical datasets. As long as there’s a story that can be told (and there always is!), I’m happy to spend time on the analysis.
